llm_fields.description: The scheme provides financial and technical assistance to leather artisan SHGs and cooperative societies to set up mechanized production units, helping them modernize production methods and improve product quality.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be leather artisans, artisan SHGs, or cooperative societies belonging to listed sub‑castes among scheduled castes; must be at least 18 years old; family annual income must not exceed ₹30,000 in rural areas or ₹25,000 in urban areas; must not have received benefits from other schemes except training programs; and family members must not be employed in government or semi‑government organizations.
